description: Get the account balance for one or more clients (what they owe or hold in credit), optionally as of a date. Mindbody: GET /client/clientaccountbalances.

balance_date.description: Balance as of this date (default today) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

class_id.description: Balance relative to this class/event id.

client_ids.description: The client ids to get balances for.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

name: mindbody_get_client_account_balances
title: Get client account balances
